test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4,000 at 6% per annum rate of interest for the period from 21 February 2024 to 22 April 2024.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,000

Rate (R) = 6% p.a.

Time = 21 February 2024 to 22 April 2024

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P times R times T)/(100)

**Calculation:**

Days in February = 29 - 21 = 8 days (2024 is a leap year)

Days in March = 31 days

Days in April = 22 days

Total Time (T) = 8 + 31 + 22 = 61 days

T (in years) = (61)/(366) = (1)/(6) year

SI = (4000 times 6 times 1)/(100 times 6)

⇒ SI = (4000)/(100)

⇒ SI = ₹40

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
